Project deep dive

Smart Quality Test System

YOLOv5 + OCR · Python/OpenCV · team of 3 · ~95% accuracy

Your strongest technical story
1. The 60-second overview

Problem → users → input → YOLOv5 detection → OCR extraction → quality decision → measured outcome. End with your exact contribution.

2. Architecture and data flow

Be ready to draw the camera/input stage, preprocessing, object detection, OCR, decision logic, storage, and web interface. Explain why each boundary exists.

3. Model and metric choices

Define what “95% accuracy” measured. Separate detection metrics from OCR accuracy, and explain the validation set and failure cases honestly.

4. Engineering trade-offs

Discuss latency versus accuracy, lighting and image quality, false accepts versus false rejects, model size, and why YOLOv5 was suitable.

5. Ownership and teamwork

Describe how you led a three-person team, split work, integrated components, resolved a blocker, and verified the final system.

6. What you would improve

Propose better data collection, experiment tracking, confidence thresholds, monitoring, testing, deployment, and a feedback loop—without pretending they already existed.
